{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
completed_sales = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute revenue per channel within each segment
revenue_by_channel_segment = completed_sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Calculate total revenue per channel (already done, but for reference)
channel_revenue = completed_sales.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Now compute average revenue per order (to adjust for volume differences)
orders_per_channel_segment = completed_sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute average revenue per order by channel and segment
avg_revenue_per_order = revenue_by_channel_segment.divide(orders_per_channel_segment)

# Display results
print("Revenue by channel and segment:")
print(revenue_by_channel_segment)

print("\nAverage revenue per order by channel and segment:")
print(avg_revenue_per_order)

# Compare average revenue per order within each segment
# We can now compare the channels fairly within each segment
print("\nAverage revenue per order per segment:")
print(avg_revenue_per_order.mean(axis=0))"}
